{"sample_id":"arvo_1304",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse",
    "line":1545,"var":"data","code":"case GNUTLS_BAG_PKCS8_KEY: import key from bag data",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input-controlled PKCS12 bag data is used to import a private key; on success sets privkey_ok=1 enabling the second loop"},
   {"step":2,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse",
    "line":1578,"var":"privkey_ok","code":"privkey_ok = 1;",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Private key successfully imported, enabling the code path that processes CRL bags in the second loop"},
   {"step":3,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse",
    "line":1734,"var":"*crl","code":"ret = gnutls_x509_crl_init(crl);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"CRL object is allocated and stored in *crl; pointer is now non-NULL"},
   {"step":4,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse",
    "line":1741,"var":"*crl","code":"ret = gnutls_x509_crl_import(*crl, &data, GNUTLS_X509_FMT_DER);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"CRL import fails because data contains invalid CRL DER, ret becomes negative"},
   {"step":5,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse",
    "line":1745,"var":"*crl","code":"gnutls_x509_crl_deinit(*crl);",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"CRL object is freed but *crl is NOT set to NULL afterwards; the dangling pointer remains"},
   {"step":6,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse",
    "line":1746,"var":"ret","code":"goto done;",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Error handling jumps to done label where cleanup code runs with ret < 0"},
   {"step":7,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse",
    "line":1791,"var":"*crl","code":"gnutls_x509_crl_deinit(*crl);",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Double-free / use-after-free: *crl still holds the freed pointer so deinit reads freed heap memory"}
 ],

   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse",
       "line":1734,"operands":["*crl"]},
      "to":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse",

      "type":"data","via":["*crl"]},
